title: Menus in the weathered style
changes: Every menu now has the same dark bronze-framed look as the game menu: hero, skills, bag, quest log, group, trading, stash, shops, villager talk and portal stones.
The Hero, Skills, Bag, Group and Menu buttons have the new look with small pixel icons, and no longer show a hover box.
Emoji icons in menus are replaced by pixel-art icons.
